row.notes: cmp rax,0x12 ; ja 0x141816e11: head of the inlined upgrade type switch in the upgrade card binder 0x1418169f0 (rax = type). Placing the hook on the head instead of the default 0x141816e11 (lea r8,["INVALID UPGRADE"]) is a choice: a redirect from the head leaves every register as the default path does (only the jump-table dispatch writes rax/rcx), and the join (lea rdx,[fmt] ; lea rcx,[buf] ; call Ne_Format_String) reads only r8. rnd-tyres sets r8 = its type suffix for 19..22 and jumps to the join; other types fall through

verify.notes: V0046 movzx eax,[rbp+0x70] ; cmp rax,0x12 ; ja 0x141816e11 head; default lea r8 'INVALID UPGRADE'; join reads only r8. Note: 'no unique signature' rationale inaccurate (head-to-default pattern is unique), harmless
